notes.deenhindi-ibnmajah:2584: Both complete originals give Ibn Umar's finite historical report about the stolen shield and its three-dirham value. Preserve the action, theft object and exact amount; do not supply an offender identity or a broader unsupplied threshold rule. The short named reporting frame is part of the source narration.
notes.deenhindi-ibnmajah:2587: Both complete fields contain Ibn Muhayriz's actual question to Fudalah and Fudalah's own sunnah answer followed by his cited account of a Prophetic action. Preserve question and answer as ordered attribution components; the Companion's sunnah classification is not direct Prophetic speech. Keep the own-source neck/hand relations and every printed word, including the Urdu spelling, without repairing from another version.
notes.deenhindi-ibnmajah:2607: Both complete originals contain Bara's actual uncle-passing encounter, the given flag, question and uncle's stated commission. The parenthetic transmitter Hushaym identification is narrator-name apparatus and remains context; the father's-wife/stepmother parenthesis is a duplicate relation gloss, also context. Preserve the source's actual after-father's-death condition and father's-wife relation. Hindi has an abbreviated question/last speech-subject join before the standalone honorific; do not fill its missing wording from Urdu. The uncle reports an assigned task, not an execution that this text explicitly says was completed.
notes.deenhindi-ibnmajah:2608: Both full originals contain Qurrah's own report of being sent concerning the person who married his father's wife, with the supplied killing and taking-all-property purposes. Preserve both purposes and the exact all-property scope without converting the commission into a claim that the actions were actually completed. Do not merge this occurrence or fill identities from the nearby Bara account. Urdu's footnote locator alone is context.
